subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-overlap Skill Workshop updates override `approvalPolicy: "auto"` and always require explicit pending approval before replacing an existing skill?
rationale: Merged PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107690 intentionally made lifecycle actions automatic by default; this safety exception is reasonable but changes that owner-defined workflow for existing users and cannot be settled by tests alone.

options.title: Confirm the safety exception
options.body: Require explicit approval for low-overlap replacements while preserving automatic approval for ordinary lifecycle actions.

options.title: Preserve automatic approval
options.body: Reject structurally invalid bodies but allow valid low-overlap replacements to follow the configured `auto` policy.

options.title: Revisit approval policy broadly
options.body: Pause this PR and define a more explicit replacement or destructive-write approval mode before changing behavior.

recommendation.title: Confirm the safety exception
recommendation.body: Require explicit approval for low-overlap replacements while preserving automatic approval for ordinary lifecycle actions.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current automatic-approval behavior and are the strongest history-based owner for approving an exception to it.
